objective: Large task scale, broad verified coverage and a unified evaluation system must be achieved together.
scope: simulation robot-use, with separately typed observation and diagnostic tracks
freeze_rule: Confirm the shared ontology, reference set and proposed support thresholds at S1, then preregister. Later changes require a version and rationale.

scale_gate.target_adjustment_rule: The 2000–3000 range is an initial target, not a ceiling; raise it if the shared reference denominator requires more.

breadth_gate.reference_missing_evidence_policy: Unknown support is not zero; do not claim the ratio until the denominator is sufficiently resolved.
breadth_gate.novelty_comparison: Report common, additional and missing cells against each reference and their union.
breadth_gate.context_admissibility: Task-relevant environment, process, resource or role differences must be evidenced. Background or domain-name changes alone do not qualify.
breadth_gate.overlap_rule: A G2 appearing in several contexts is counted once globally and once in each valid context-binding set.
breadth_gate.R6_status: continued expansion, requires actual adapter and validated eligibility

distribution_policy.task_bank: Keep all eligible validated tasks and disclose actual distribution and overlap; do not delete tasks merely to enforce visual balance.
distribution_policy.primary_aggregation: equal weight per preregistered core context, then preregistered family/task weights within each context
distribution_policy.model_case_selection: The eligible set is fixed by the release contract, not selected by each model.

counting_model.instances: actual assets and physical/agent initial states attached to execution bindings
counting_model.cases: typed valid input/evidence, instance and scoring contracts

capacity_example.status: conditional planning example, not observed data

preserved_design_materials.legacy_100_140_blueprints: historical deep-annotation budget, not the full task-bank target
